# PracticalLab Africa — Copilot instructions

Before changing product behavior or code, read:

- `docs/instructions.md` for permanent engineering and product rules.
- `docs/Project Proposal PracticalLab Africa (Virtual Practical Learning Platform).md` for approved product scope.
- `docs/PracticalLab Africa Design and Interface Guidelines v1.0.md` for design requirements.
- `docs/PLAN.md` for the active milestone and progress.

The filenames above are the canonical source files in this workspace. Do not assume that similarly named numbered documents exist.

Work only on the approved milestone. Keep changes small, write and run relevant tests, update `docs/PLAN.md` after each milestone, and wait for product-owner confirmation before starting the next milestone. Do not add dependencies or expand scope without approval. Never expose secrets or log personal data. Preserve the individual-only account model, mandatory teacher verification, student privacy defaults, required MVP safety controls, reviewed content publishing, and teacher-screen-only Live mode.
